input_messages.content: Hi, I need to exchange a T-shirt I bought. It’s just too big for me. I’m hoping to get the same one, just a size smaller. Can you help with that?
My name is Sofia Thomas. My email is sofia.thomas3019@example.com. I’m not sure about the order ID right now—do I really need it? I just want to swap it for a smaller size.
Oh, I didn’t realize you’d need that too. My zip code is 10027. My name is Sofia Thomas. I really hope this works, because I just want to get the right size.

I’m honestly not sure what else to give you. The only other email I might have used is sofia.thomas3069@example.com. I really don’t have the order ID handy. Is there any other way you can help me? I just want to exchange this T-shirt for a smaller size.
Yes, please, that would be helpful. I don’t have the order ID or item numbers with me. Can you check my recent orders and see which T-shirt I bought? I just want the same one, but one size smaller.

Yes, please list the available options for the smaller sizes. I’d like to see what’s there before deciding. Also, if there are different colors, I’d prefer black if that’s possible. For the payment method, I’d rather get any refund back to the card I used for the original purchase.

I’d like to exchange it for the black, size XL, cotton one—item ID 2060066974. And yes, please send any refund or payment adjustment back to my PayPal. I hope this works out, because I really liked the cotton feel of the original.
Yes, that’s all correct. Please go ahead and process the exchange. I just hope there won’t be any issues with the return.

Thank you for your help. I’ll look out for the email and hope everything goes smoothly this time. That’s all I needed. 

###STOP###
